name: Agi Inc
summary:
Agi (AGBK) reported earnings of $0.26 per share on revenue of $568.99 million for the first quarter ended March 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.25 per share on revenue of $445.13 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 4.00%.

Agi stands for a banking experience that welcomes and empowers all Brazilians through a business model that is unique in Brazil.
subject: Agi Beat Consensus Estimates
